Messages.Author: Peter D Bakija
Messages.Body:
Can you use multiple Couriers on a single bleed action to discard multiple
cards off of your prey's deck? The significant wording on Courier is, more or
less, "When you bleed your prey, you may look at the top card of their deck,
and you may tap Courier to make them discard that card". Now that Iam paying
attention, it looks like you can only use one Courier per bleed action (which
is sad :-(, but maybe not.

Thanks,

Messages.Author: Noal McDonald
Messages.Body:
pd...@aol.comANTISPAM (Peter D Bakija) wrote:
> Can you use multiple Couriers on a single bleed action to
> discard multiple cards off of your prey's deck?

LSJ ruled earlier that you can.

> The significant wording on Courier is, more or less, "When you bleed
> your prey, you may look at the top card of their deck, and you may
> tap Courier to make them discard that card".

...and when you discard the top card, there will be a new top card of
their deck and the next Courier can look at it.

I've got a deck with 15 Couriers and 10 Dirty Little Secrets in it.
Between that and the 4 SRs and 4 DIs in it, it's been fairly effective
at letting my prey play only what I allow him to.

Regards,
